storm_reports.quote: Outlook article published 7:49 am IST; rain began ~3 am; Delhi Traffic Police: waterlogging on Ring Road Naraina-Moti Bagh, Azad Market underpass, Aurobindo Marg towards AIIMS, W-Point Tilak Bridge road
Delhi recorded 228 mm in 24 hours to 8:30 am Friday (highest June 24-hr since 1936); waterlogging at ITO, Moolchand, Minto Bridge, Saket, Sarita Vihar; Pragati Maidan tunnel closed

Several parts of Delhi remained waterlogged on Thursday, August 1 (ITO, Rajghat, Mother Dairy, Ganesh Nagar, Patparganj Road); 107 mm at Safdarjung in prior 24 hrs; 119 waterlogging calls till midnight Wed 31 Jul, 8 more till 7 am (published 6:38 pm)

The Week 8 Aug 2026: heavy rains submerged key roads - Kapashera, Badarpur jams; waterlogging Gadaipur, Karmapura, Karol Bagh (rain of Fri 7 Aug); also PTI 6 Aug 19:26 IST for Sangam Vihar, Defence Colony etc. at https://thefederal.com/category/states/north/delhi/heavy-rain-delhi-waterlogging-major-roads-252757

Hans India created 5:52 AM IST: Mehrauli-Badarpur Rd near Okhla Mor ~3 ft water, Zakira underpass flooded (storm of Mon 24 Aug); Patriot/Pioneer 25 Aug: Ashoka Road, Raisina Rd, RML, around Supreme Court and AIIMS waterlogged in early hours of Tue 25 Aug
